claim_domain.policy_class: all deterministic observable finite-history rules respecting the declared gate and known-denial rejection, and all ex ante world-independent mixtures thereof
claim_domain.cap_scope: explicit bounded submodel; no unrestricted architecture conclusion

information.history: H_t: paid initial technical prior, requests, response bodies and metadata, actual cost/time/balance signals, scoped own evidence, commitments, attempts and post-effect receipts
information.filtration: F_obs_t = sigma(H_t); policy choices measurable with respect to F_obs_t plus independent policy seed U
information.allowed_inference: All correlations and after-effect observations actually available; no exclusion merely because they refute a bound
information.known_M: Mandate has active(m)=1; known M permission evidence is included in charged setup, without chi
information.no_symbol_override: Base mu/sigma describe generated benefits; base v describes review allocation. Use mu_world, F_obs and v_exec to distinguish probability law, observable information and executed violation.

success: e=1 iff a=1 and q>=J_star-epsilon and C<=R and t_del<=T and v_exec=0

metrics.z_complete: raw technical finish; separate from legitimate/time-bounded completion
metrics.a: complete admissible result delivered by T, regardless of meeting quality or cost threshold; distinct from all-campaign violation flag
metrics.q: nonnegative J of that complete admissible delivered composition by T; 0 if absent; not a compensation for violation
metrics.J_partial: technical reward of performed actions; report separately; do not add to q
metrics.v_exec: 1 iff at least one executed campaign violation; blocked/proposed attempts do not count; permanent across recovery
metrics.f: population probability or empirical fraction of campaigns with v_exec=1, explicitly identified
metrics.C: sum unique incurred operational ledger entries through closure, including preparation/failed/discarded/repeated work and coordination exactly once
metrics.C_per_delivery: total C across registered runs divided by number of complete admissible on-time deliveries a=1; undefined when denominator zero; retain total C
metrics.C_per_success: total C across registered runs divided by number of joint successes e=1; distinct from cost per legitimate delivery; undefined when denominator zero; retain total C
metrics.t_del: timestamp of legitimate delivery by T or null; late delivery reported separately
metrics.K: itemized coordination work/cost already included once in C
metrics.severity: categorical obligation type and registered severity, counts and tasks affected; no monetary harm inference without a separate model
metrics.truth_unknown: retain known fields; success UNKNOWN unless a separately established hard failure already implies e=0; never assign a timeout a zero optimum

comparisons.AVG: exists one lambda: sum mu_world*s_omega>=p_min and sum mu_world*r_omega<=delta
comparisons.WC: exists one lambda for all worlds: s_omega>=p_min and r_omega<=delta
comparisons.full_information: for all worlds exists a world-informed control: physical check only, not hidden-world adequacy
comparisons.U: logical complement of F with strict failure of at least one inequality; not measured-family failure
comparisons.unresolved: evidence status, not a third logical feasible set
comparisons.boundaries: all success thresholds inclusive; epsilon absolute J gap
comparisons.risk_redundancy: delta>=1-p_min makes risk ceiling redundant because success and violation are disjoint

operational_charge_clarifications.setup: 2 covers the model’s entire registered technical-prior acquisition and known-M evidence production/use; favorable synthetic prior, not a measured production estimate

binding_certificate.origin: binding-register factual chi at v1; not the evaluator or new normative authority

operational_charge_clarifications.state_query: 1 includes all service work for the registered factual state result; no separately free preparation assumed
operational_charge_clarifications.sampling_compilation: explicit mathematical zero fixed charge; not runtime engineering evidence
operational_charge_clarifications.connectors: zero-benefit connectors bundled in node execution; no extra hidden charge
operational_charge_clarifications.repeat_and_cache: Distinct actual events charged once each, including repeated work; reused already acquired facts cost the declared reuse charge and cannot certify new scope

lower_local_review_price.interpretation: changed cost coordinate, not a counterexample inside fixed M02 theta

informative_prior_asymmetric.interpretation: changed distribution resolves AVG requirements for this tested policy, not WC

diagnostic_variants.epsilon3: existing M02 countercontrol at R11; common M meets quality boundary

statistics.exact_fixture: known distribution exact calculation, not binomial sample evidence
statistics.future_campaign: C11 must freeze units, sample/precision, paired design, world clustering, margins/multiplicity and missing data before C12
statistics.zero_event_IID_one_sided_upper: 1 - alpha**(1/n), only for n independent identically distributed Bernoulli trials with zero observed violations and predeclared confidence 1-alpha
statistics.cluster_warning: events/agents/repeats sharing a world or evidence are not automatically independent trials
statistics.classifier: adequate only with required simultaneous lower-success/upper-risk bounds; inadequate for evaluated family only with each competent registered arm reliably failing at least one constraint; else unresolved

task_scope: M10 contract reconciliation and P03 measurement-validity audit; M06 source intake and M11/P10 inputs are partial; C02/C11 implementation/statistical freeze and M03/M04 bounds remain separate
